# Cyrus owner test deploy (release candidate rc1)

Written 2026-10-11 by the rc1 agent on `release/cyrus-rc1` (= `feature/cyrus-r2` + `main` e62aa07c6d). **Nothing here has been run on production.** The parent/owner runs it, one step at a time, on the primary, in a quiet hour. After each step: run its smoke, read it, go on only when it is clean. Every step has its own rollback.

Goal: the owner tests Minecraft mods with **textures, sounds, item models (item states) and designers** on his own server, as the only preview account. Every public switch stays OFF. The full background runbook is [CYRUS-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md](CYRUS-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md); this page is the owner-test subset, with the exact values.

## Facts this plan is built on (from the 2026-10-11 03:17 backup, restored to a throwaway DB, read-only)

| | |
|---|---|
| Preview account | `nicholas.sj.albanese@gmail.com` (user `cmrztujaw0002hlazl58i3lsi`, role CUSTOMER, not suspended). No `preview_access_emails*` Setting row exists, so `lib/preview-access.ts` falls back to `DEFAULT_PREVIEW_EMAILS` = this account. **Nothing to add.** Do NOT create a `preview_access_emails` row unless you want to change the list: a row replaces the default. |
| Cyrus usage in prod | No `cyrus_*` Setting row at all (every setting = its default, the launch pair is off). One `CyrusTokenAccount` (the owner, `tierOverride=all`), zero `CyrusPlan` rows, 17 builds, all by the owner. |
| Test server | `minecraft-f3izjh` (label "My server"), id `cmuzuj8wl00xshlv49mfv4a1p`, **owned by the preview account** (no grant or ownership change needed). Paper **1.21.11**, `MEMORY=4G`, online-mode false. Plan "Minecraft 4 GB / 20 slots" (4096 MB, 2 cores, 30 GB). VM 88006 on **node-7** (`nxeon-sgp4`, OVH SGP), guest 10.20.6.101, join `139.99.125.190:20117`. RUNNING. Three earlier Cyrus mods are installed and DISABLED (Handgun9mm 1.0.0, Banshee 1.2.0, RandomDrops 1.3.0). |
| Build target | **Minecraft 1.21.11 (Paper)**: the server's version and the most-verified lane (Test Flight classpath, item model definitions, sounds, designers). No 26.x needed, so no `JDK25=yes`. |
| RAM | Pack Loader is a 12 KB plugin; the resource pack is downloaded by the client from `cyrus.my`, not held by the server. Extra server memory is negligible. Note: the heap (`MEMORY=4G`) already equals the VM's 4096 MB; that is today's setting, not caused by this release. Look at the panel's RAM graph before the test. |
| How delivery reaches node-7 | The same path as today's Cyrus installs: the worker on the primary opens the guest through the Mods engine (`ENABLE_REAL_GAMEMODS=1`, already on) and writes `/opt/mc/plugins`. With `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1` the same Install also places Pack Loader (from `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGIN_DIR` on the primary) and its pack config (pack URL + sha1). |

## 0. Before anything

```
uptime                                   # load under ~4, no promote/agent build running
/opt/nxeon/scripts/devhost status        # node-2: build lock free (the promote builds there)
df -h / /tank                            # root >= 5 GB free
ls -la /tank/backup/db | tail -2         # tonight's nxeon-*.sql.gz exists
git -C /opt/nxeon rev-parse --short main # must be e62aa07c6d; if main moved, ask the rc agent to merge it first
```

## 1. Code: fast-forward main, then the database, then promote (all switches off)

**1a. Merge.** `release/cyrus-rc1` contains main, so this is a fast-forward (review the PR/diff first):

```
git -C /opt/nxeon merge --ff-only release/cyrus-rc1
```

Rollback before the promote: `git -C /opt/nxeon reset --keep e62aa07c6d` (only if nobody committed on top).

**1b. Manual SQL, before the promote** (rehearsed on the restored backup; each file ran in under 0.2 s, all inside one transaction each):

```
URL="$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' /opt/nxeon/.env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"')"
cd /opt/nxeon
for f in 2026-10-10-cyrus-engine-core 2026-10-10-cyrus-managed-plugins 2026-10-10-cyrus-catalog-v2 \
         2026-10-10-cyrus-library-backend 2026-10-11-cyrus-model-drafts 2026-10-11-cyrus-legal-cases \
         2026-10-11-cyrus-notifications 2026-10-11-cyrus-ticket-context; do
  echo "== $f"; psql "$URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -1 -f prisma/manual-migrations/$f.sql || break
done
```

Expected: only `CREATE ...` lines and two NOTICEs (`trigger "cyrus_revision_immutable" ... does not exist, skipping`; model-drafts `column "surface" ... already exists, skipping`).

- `library-backend` runs `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm`; production has no pg_trgm today. If the production role may not create it, that file fails and rolls back by itself: then skip it and go on (db push creates its tables; the two GIN indexes can be added later; nothing reads them while `CYRUS_LIBRARY_BACKEND` is off).
- Do **not** run the DRAFT `2026-10-10-cyrus-mod-health-telemetry.sql`, nor the proposals `prisma/manual-migration-cyrus-{api-v1,bridge-grants,r44-bridge,r44-data-jobs}.sql`: some of their tables are not in `schema.prisma`, and a later `db push --accept-data-loss` (staging always passes it) would drop them.

Verify: `bash scripts/cyrus/smoke-readonly.sh migrations` (10 OK tables, OK trigger; "CyrusManagedPlugin is empty" until 1d). Rollback: drop the 20 new tables (they are empty), see the Rollback column of the main runbook step 1.

**1c. Promote** (staging optional; the rehearsal covered the schema):

```
bash /opt/nxeon/scripts/promote-production.sh --skip-staging-check
```

Rehearsal of its `db push` on the restored backup, after 1b: 10 statements left (CREATE TABLE/INDEX for `CyrusAttribution`, `CyrusConversion`, `CyrusPersonalApiKey`, `CyrusDataRequest`), no data-loss warning, "in sync" in 2 s, second push a no-op. Without 1b the push would make 72 statements, all CREATE (no ALTER, no DROP).

Smoke:
```
bash scripts/cyrus/smoke-readonly.sh migrations worker flags
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://nxeon.cloud/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://nxeon.cloud/login
systemctl status nxeon-worker --no-pager | head -5; journalctl -u nxeon-worker --since -5min --no-pager | grep -iE 'error|cannot find|unhandled' | head
```
The worker line matters: `worker/game-mods.ts` now imports the delivery orchestrator at load, so a broken import would stop the worker (the promote only WARNs). Rollback: `bash /opt/nxeon/scripts/rollback-release.sh --production` (web) and `systemctl restart nxeon-worker` after `git -C /opt/nxeon reset --keep e62aa07c6d`. The new tables can stay.

**1d. Seed** (writes only `CyrusManagedPlugin`, idempotent; 3 rows in the rehearsal):
```
cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx scripts/cyrus-seed-managed-plugins.ts      # "seeded 3 managed plugin catalog row(s)"
```
Rollback: `DELETE FROM "CyrusManagedPlugin";`

## 2. Pack hosting on local disk, served by nginx at https://cyrus.my/packs/

The local store writes `<CYRUS_PACK_LOCAL_DIR>/p/<sha1>.zip` and publishes `<CYRUS_PACK_PUBLIC_BASE>/p/<sha1>.zip` (lib/cyrus/packhost/local.ts, types.ts `publicPackUrl`). Packs live on **/tank** (the root disk is the one that filled up on 2026-09-27). The web (user `nxeon`) and the worker (root) both write; nginx (`www-data`) reads.

```
install -d -m 2775 -o root -g nxeon /tank/cyrus-packs /tank/cyrus-packs/p
```

Add inside the **443** `server` block of `/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/cyrus-my`, before `location / {...}` (tested 8/8 on a throwaway nginx 1.26 with this exact block: a stored pack answers 200 `application/zip` byte-identical; wrong names, `/packs/`, `/packs/p/`, traversal, trailing slash 404; POST 403):

```
    # Cyrus resource packs (owner test). Content-addressed, immutable. Only GET/HEAD of p/<40 hex>.zip.
    location /packs/ {
        location ~ "^/packs/p/([0-9a-f]{40})\.zip$" {
            alias /tank/cyrus-packs/p/$1.zip;
            default_type application/zip;
            types { }
            limit_except GET HEAD { deny all; }
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
            add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
            add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000" always;
        }
        return 404;
    }
```
```
cp /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/cyrus-my /root/cyrus-my.bak-$(date +%s) && nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
cp /tank/cyrus-rc1-artifacts/canary.zip /tank/cyrus-packs/p/9f4c54e3e74ddb851073f44734fdd640cfab3a1e.zip
curl -s -A 'Java/21.0.5' https://cyrus.my/packs/p/9f4c54e3e74ddb851073f44734fdd640cfab3a1e.zip | sha1sum   # must print 9f4c54e3...3a1e
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://cyrus.my/   # landing still 200
```
The Java user agent check proves Cloudflare (apex is proxied) hands the pack to a Minecraft client without a challenge. If it returns HTML, turn off Bot Fight Mode / add a WAF skip rule for `/packs/` in the Cloudflare dashboard. Rollback: restore the `.bak` file, `nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx`. Remove the canary after the test.

## 3. Pack Loader jar (managed plugin)

Built reproducibly on node-2 (`services/modbuilder/tools/packloader/build.sh` with Temurin 21 and the 1.21.11 paper-api classpath, twice, same bytes); sha256 `0ff1078ef79eda8e08c9af496ac482b23803b53093e2ee963475ea8c61ba0580` = the pin in `lib/cyrus/managed/catalog.json`. Staged at `/tank/cyrus-rc1-artifacts/NxeonPackLoader-0.1.0.jar`.

```
install -d -m 755 /tank/cyrus-managed/nxeon-pack-loader
install -m 644 /tank/cyrus-rc1-artifacts/NxeonPackLoader-0.1.0.jar /tank/cyrus-managed/nxeon-pack-loader/
sha256sum /tank/cyrus-managed/nxeon-pack-loader/NxeonPackLoader-0.1.0.jar   # must equal the pin
```
To rebuild it yourself: on node-2, `bash services/modbuilder/tools/packloader/build.sh /tank/nxeon-build/tmp/testflight/jdk/21 /tank/nxeon-build/tmp/testflight/classpath/1.21.11.txt /tmp/x.jar`. Rollback: delete the directory (nothing uses it while `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL` is off).

## 4. Build-service image on VM 88001 (independent of the site)

Tested off the VM: the service from this tree, run on node-2 in a private network namespace, answers `/health` with `assets: texture, sound, datapack, design, itemmodel`, `catalogTools:true`, `promptVersion mb-2026-10-09.1`, `release.scannerSha256 = sha256(scan.js) 83d1da31...419f`, `registrySha256 d3502380...8196`. A full `docker build` cannot run off the VM (its base image `claudebox:14f689d` and `toolchain.tgz` exist only there; node-2 has no Docker), so the script's own build + health + auto-rollback is the safety net.

```
cd /opt/nxeon
bash scripts/cyrus/deploy-modbuilder.sh --list           # file list, touches nothing
TAG=modbuilder:0.6 bash scripts/cyrus/deploy-modbuilder.sh   # no JDK25 (1.21.11 only); prints PREV tag + backup name
bash scripts/cyrus/smoke-readonly.sh service
```
The script refuses unless the service is idle, records the running tag, rebuilds, checks promptVersion / catalogTools / scanner sha / registry sha, sends one injection request that must be refused (one guard call on the subscription login), and rolls back by itself on any failure. Rollback by hand: the line it prints (`tar xzf .backup-<ts>.tgz ... && ./run.sh <previous image>`). Stay on the subscription login: fine for the owner as the only preview account.

## 5. Environment (secrets generated now, never committed)

Both units read `/opt/nxeon/.env`. The sound render needs **different** values in the two processes (web `relay`, worker `ssh`), so the worker gets one extra env file through a drop-in (a later `EnvironmentFile=` overrides an earlier one).

```
TOK=$(openssl rand -hex 24)
cp /opt/nxeon/.env /root/nxeon.env.bak-$(date +%s)
cat >> /opt/nxeon/.env <<EOF
# --- Cyrus owner test (docs/CYRUS-TEST-DEPLOY.md) ---
CYRUS_PACK_STORE=local
CYRUS_PACK_LOCAL_DIR=/tank/cyrus-packs
CYRUS_PACK_PUBLIC_BASE=https://cyrus.my/packs
CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGIN_DIR=/tank/cyrus-managed
CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER=relay
CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47380
CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_TOKEN=$TOK
CYRUS_DESIGNER=1
CYRUS_ITEM_STATES=1
CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE=1
CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_BLOCK_ON_FAIL=1
CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1
CYRUS_DELIVERY=1
EOF
install -m 600 /dev/null /etc/nxeon/cyrus-worker.env
printf 'CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER=ssh\nCYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_PORT=47380\nCYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_TOKEN=%s\n' "$TOK" > /etc/nxeon/cyrus-worker.env
printf '[Service]\nEnvironmentFile=-/etc/nxeon/cyrus-worker.env\n' > /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-worker.service.d/cyrus-worker-env.conf
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart nxeon-worker            # 120 s graceful stop; builds continue on the VM
systemctl restart nxeon-web               # quiet minute: a few seconds of 502
unset TOK
```
(47380 was free on the primary on 2026-10-11: `ss -ltn | grep 47380` must print nothing first.) The node-2 render prerequisites exist: `/tank/nxeon-build/tmp/sound-render` and `/tank/nxeon-build/tmp/ffmpeg/current/bin/ffmpeg`.

Smoke: `bash scripts/cyrus/smoke-readonly.sh flags worker packs owner` (the new `owner` step checks the pack dir mode, a stored pack downloading byte-identical with a Java user agent, the Pack Loader jar against the pin, relay health with the token, the same token in both files, the running worker seeing `ssh` and the web not). `journalctl -u nxeon-worker | grep cyrus-sound-relay` shows `listening on 127.0.0.1:47380`.

Rollback (whole step): copy the `.env` backup back, `rm /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-worker.service.d/cyrus-worker-env.conf /etc/nxeon/cyrus-worker.env`, `systemctl daemon-reload`, restart both. Per switch: delete that one line and restart the process(es) named below.

**What each line opens, in test order** (only the preview account can reach any of it while the launch pair is off):

| Order | Line (process) | Owner check |
|---|---|---|
| 6.1 | `CYRUS_DESIGNER=1` (web) | Item/ability, menu, quest, boss, HUD/glyph, motion designers in the project |
| 6.2 | `CYRUS_ITEM_STATES=1` (web) | Item model states (bow pull, gun aim, display contexts) |
| 6.5 | nothing to switch | Texture, Sound and Model Studios are already open to preview accounts with `cyrus_studios_enabled` OFF (`studiosOpen = cyrusUser && (preview || flag)`); keep the settings off so customers never see them |
| 5c | `CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER` relay/ssh + token | Sound Studio preview plays; builds ship rendered sounds |
| 6.7 | `CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE=1` (worker), `CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_BLOCK_ON_FAIL=1` (web + worker) | Every finished build boots on node-2 first; a failed flight blocks Install (protects the real server) |
| 6.8 | `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL=1` (web + worker), then `CYRUS_DELIVERY=1` (web + worker) | The normal Install also places Pack Loader + the pack; the designers' Ship bar uses `/api/cyrus/delivery/v1` |

## 6. Supervised delivery to minecraft-f3izjh (owner at the keyboard, parent watching)

1. Panel: take a backup of `minecraft-f3izjh` (Backups > Create). Note RAM use on the overview.
2. Watch: `journalctl -fu nxeon-worker | grep -iE 'cyrus|game-mod|testflight'` in one terminal.
3. As the owner, `/dashboard/cyrus` > New mod > Minecraft **1.21.11**. One prompt that touches every lane, e.g. "A ruby sword with a custom red texture, a custom swing sound with a subtitle, and a pistol whose model changes while aiming and reloading; add an item designer ability: right-click fires a small fireball." (one model build on the subscription login).
4. Wait for **Test Flight: passed** on the build. A failed flight blocks Install: read the verdict, do not force it.
5. Texture Studio: change one colour, save (a revision). Sound Studio: press Play on the swing sound (relay check). Designer: open the item, check the ability, Ship.
6. Install > `minecraft-f3izjh` > acknowledge the plan warnings > restart now. Status must end `succeeded` (`rolled_back` / `rollback_incomplete` are shown as such; then stop and read `steps[]`).
7. `bash scripts/cyrus/smoke-readonly.sh delivery owner` (no stuck jobs; the pack on disk downloads byte-identical).
8. Uninstall at the end from the same Install screen (or keep it). If anything is left half-done: restore the step-1 backup (the restore now sizes the VM from the game plan, fixed in e62aa07c6d).

**In the real Minecraft client (Java 1.21.11, Multiplayer > Direct Connection > `139.99.125.190:20117`)**, the same checks as the test-day kit (`lib/cyrus/eval/testday.ts`):
- `pack.prompt` the server offers the pack on join; accept. `pack.applied` Options > Resource Packs shows it.
- `tex.hand` / `tex.gui` the ruby sword has the new texture in hand and in the inventory; `ctx.thirdperson`, `ctx.ground`, `ctx.frame`, `ctx.head` look right (F5, drop, item frame, on the head).
- `states.idle` / `states.aiming` / `states.reloading` the pistol model changes while holding right click and while reloading.
- `snd.play` / `snd.subtitle` with Show Subtitles on, the swing sound plays and its subtitle appears.
- designer: the ability fires; menus/quests/boss/HUD if the mod has them (`hud.glyph` for a HUD glyph).
- Then `/plugins` shows the mod and `NxeonPackLoader` green; leave and rejoin (the pack is cached by sha1, no second download).

Optional, no production needed: the full kit on node-2 throwaway servers, `scripts/cyrus/testday.sh build`, `fetch`, `start 1.21.11 <your Minecraft name>`, follow `CHECKLIST.md`, `stop`, `ingest results.json --apply`.

## 7. What stays OFF

`cyrus_studio_public_enabled` + `cyrus_tok_live` (the pair), `cyrus_public_enabled`, `cyrus_studios_enabled`, `cyrus_model_studio_enabled`, `cyrus_model_editor_enabled`, `cyrus_import_enabled`, `cyrus_mods_public_enabled`, `cyrus_passrate_enabled`; env `CYRUS_DATAPACK_STUDIO`, `CYRUS_WORLDGEN`, `CYRUS_DATAPACK_DELIVERY_REAL`, `CYRUS_CREATURES`, `CYRUS_MESHGEN*`, `CYRUS_CATALOG_TOOLS`, `CYRUS_LIBRARY_BACKEND`, `CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_CLEARED`, `CYRUS_MODPACKS*`, `CYRUS_PLAYTEST`, `CYRUS_LIVE_ASSETS`, `CYRUS_MOD_SUITES`, `CYRUS_TRY_IT*`, `CYRUS_LEGACY_TEXTURES`, `CYRUS_BUILD_MATRIX`, `CYRUS_CUSTOMER_APP`, `CYRUS_DOMAIN_MODE` + bridge, `CYRUS_API_V1*`, `CYRUS_PLATFORM_EVENTS`, `CYRUS_SERVER_GRANTS`, `CYRUS_NOTIFY`, `CYRUS_SERVER_BUTTON`, `CYRUS_ADMIN_SUMMARY`, `CYRUS_DATABASE_URL`, `TERMINAL_WS_PING_MS` / `CONSOLE_WS_PING_MS` / `WS_KEEPALIVE_MS`.

## 8. Post-deploy smoke (run after every step above, and once at the end)

```
cd /opt/nxeon && bash scripts/cyrus/smoke-readonly.sh all      # exits 1 on any FAIL; never prints a secret
```
Plus, as a normal (non-preview) account in a private window: `/`, `/login`, `/dashboard`, a game server page, `/dashboard/cyrus` (must 404), checkout start. Nothing Cyrus may appear.

## Appendix: neutrality proof (every Cyrus switch off)

See `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/AW-release-candidate.md` for the file-by-file table. In short: every change to code customers use today is behind a switch that is unset in production (checked by name in `/opt/nxeon/.env`: no `CYRUS_*`, no `WS_*` ping variable, no `CYRUS_DATABASE_URL`) or behaves the same; the Prisma schema change is new models only (293 existing tables byte-identical after the rehearsed migration); the changes that do run for everyone are listed there as risks.

## 2. Pack hosting on local disk, served by nginx at https://cyrus.my/packs/

The local store writes `<CYRUS_PACK_LOCAL_DIR>/p/<sha1>.zip` and publishes `<CYRUS_PACK_PUBLIC_BASE>/p/<sha1>.zip` (lib/cyrus/packhost/local.ts, types.ts `publicPackUrl`). Packs live on **/tank** (the root disk is the one that filled up on 2026-09-27). The web (user `nxeon`) and the worker (root) both write; nginx (`www-data`) reads.

```
install -d -m 2775 -o root -g nxeon /tank/cyrus-packs /tank/cyrus-packs/p
```

Add inside the **443** `server` block of `/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/cyrus-my`, before `location / {...}` (tested 8/8 on a throwaway nginx 1.26 with this exact block: a stored pack answers 200 `application/zip` byte-identical; wrong names, `/packs/`, `/packs/p/`, traversal, trailing slash 404; POST 403):

```
    # Cyrus resource packs (owner test). Content-addressed, immutable. Only GET/HEAD of p/<40 hex>.zip.
    location /packs/ {
        location ~ "^/packs/p/([0-9a-f]{40})\.zip$" {
            alias /tank/cyrus-packs/p/$1.zip;
            default_type application/zip;
            types { }
            limit_except GET HEAD { deny all; }
            add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
            add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
            add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000" always;
        }
        return 404;
    }
```

**Production state it relies on** (checked 2026-10-11, read-only): `/opt/nxeon/.env` has no `CYRUS_*` name, no `WS_KEEPALIVE_MS` / `TERMINAL_WS_PING_MS` / `CONSOLE_WS_PING_MS`, no `CYRUS_DATABASE_URL`; the DB has no `cyrus_*` or `preview_access*` Setting row; the only Cyrus user is the owner.

**Screens** (`scripts/cyrus/rc-neutral-fixtures.ts` + `rc-neutral-shots.mjs`, a `next start` of each build on node-2, a normal customer with one Minecraft server + an admin, no Cyrus setting written): rc1 and main both answer 200 for `/`, `/login`, `/game-servers`, `/dashboard`, the server page, `/dashboard/deploy`, `/dashboard/billing`, `/admin`; `/dashboard/cyrus` shows the 404 page on both; zero "Cyrus" text and zero page errors on every page. **Code paths customers use today** (diff e62aa07c6d..rc1):

| Area | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| middleware.ts | gated | Cyrus host mode only with `CYRUS_DOMAIN_MODE=1` + exact host. Always on: `/cyrus-host*` answers 404 (a new internal path) and the `x-cyrus-host` header is stripped from every request (anti-spoofing). |
| lib/auth.ts, app/login | gated | `bridgeConfig().enabled` false: same cookie, same `assertSessionToken` rule (`cyrusHost=false` keeps the main branch); "Sign in with Cyrus" not rendered. |
| Top bar / Shell.tsx, dashboard layout | same for customers | Cyrus button and credit widget only for Cyrus-entitled viewers (the owner); the full-screen mode only under `/dashboard/cyrus*` (404 for customers); one `sessionStorage` write in try/catch. Layout marker header only set by middleware in domain mode. |
| Server page, support, admin home | gated / same | `CYRUS_SERVER_BUTTON`, `CYRUS_ADMIN_SUMMARY` off; ticket form changes only with `?cyrusBuild=`; admin ticket panel reads a new table, errors caught. |
| Billing / Stripe (renew, game order, worker billing, refund) | same | Same grant calls through `lib/nxeon-platform/server-tokens.ts`; event emit needs `CYRUS_PLATFORM_EVENTS`; grants are a no-op outside the token economy (one read, as before). |
| Worker | gated | New ticks (platform events/watch, testflight gate, webhooks, data jobs, conversions, build matrix, meshgen) return before any I/O without their env switch; old Cyrus sweeps keep cadence via the host seam. `worker/game-mods.ts` now imports the delivery orchestrator at load: **check the worker starts** (step 1c). |
| WebSocket servers | gated | Pings only with a `*_PING_MS` / `WS_KEEPALIVE_MS` value; a missing pong closes nothing. |
| DB accessor / host seam | same | `cyrusDb` = Nxeon's client unless `CYRUS_DATABASE_URL` differs; lib/db.ts unchanged. |
| Schema | additive | New models only; rehearsal: 293 existing tables count+checksum identical, 0 indexes lost, the existing expression index kept. |
| geo-ip / checkout IP | same under nginx | `clientIp` (last trusted hop, then X-Real-IP) instead of X-Real-IP first; identical while Nxeon zones are not behind Cloudflare. |
| Mod Builder / Cyrus paths, tokens | owner only | Launch pair now needs both settings (both off); token rollover/lapse/claw-back defaults changed but only touch accounts with plan or grant lots (none but the owner); `syncBuildRow` adds a cached `/health` read per finished build. |
| Light theme CSS | additive | 9 new rules for colour literals used only on Cyrus screens. |
| Build | changed | `npm run build` sets a 6 GB heap; `next build` type-checks via `tsconfig.next.json` (app only). |
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
E

# AW: Cyrus release candidate rc1, go/no-go (2026-10-11)

Branch `release/cyrus-rc1` (worktree `/tank/dev-worktrees/cyrus-rc1`) = `feature/cyrus-r2` + main `e62aa07c6d` + r49 QA 1/5-4/5. Nothing deployed. Runbook: `docs/CYRUS-TEST-DEPLOY.md`.

## Verdict: GO for the owner-only test, after a code review of the branch

## Found and fixed
- **The merged tree could not be built.** Its type check ran out of memory (full program 6.3 GB heap; main 3.5 GB; the promote runs with Node's 4 GB default). Fixed: one structural PrismaClient comparison in `lib/cyrus/host/nxeon.ts` cost ~1.1M types; `next build` now checks the app through `tsconfig.next.json`; `npm run build` sets a 6 GB heap. `npm run build` (the promote's command) passes on node-2. `devhost tsc` (5 GB) now dies without a message: use `devhost run -- env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7168 npx tsc --noEmit`. Earlier "tsc clean" claims on r2 are suspect.
- Two checks the main merge exposed: an auth source-regex test and the stale light-theme CSS.
- `smoke-readonly.sh` ran only its first step when given several. Fixed, and it has a new `owner` step.

## Tests compared with main
- Full suite: rc1 6820 tests, 50 fail; main 52 fail. Each failure left over was re-run on both trees: they fail on main too (admin MRR/revenue, chat plans with a DB) or are flaky (files-download timing, a port clash).
- The host seam, db split, docs coverage and Dockerfile tests pass: 27/27.
- tsc: 0 errors.

## Neutral (every switch off)
Production `.env` has no `CYRUS_*`, no WebSocket ping variable and no `CYRUS_DATABASE_URL`. The DB has no `cyrus_*` or preview Setting row. The only Cyrus user is the owner.

Screens: a normal customer and an admin on rc1 and on main both get 200 on 9 pages, with zero Cyrus text. `/dashboard/cyrus` shows 404. Pixels differ by 0-0.08%; the login page differs by 1.15%, which is its random wallpaper. The file-by-file table is in the runbook appendix.

## Risky (small, reviewed)
- `worker/game-mods.ts` now loads the delivery orchestrator at start. Check that the worker starts after the promote.
- Everyone gets `/cyrus-host*` → 404, the `x-cyrus-host` header stripped, and a slightly changed logout cookie (r49).
- The client IP comes from a new helper. It gives the same IP behind nginx.
- Token defaults changed. They reach only the owner.
- `pg_trgm` is not on prod. If creating it is refused, skip the library file.
- r49 5/5 is not in this branch: re-merge and re-run before the deploy.

## Rehearsal (restored 03:17 backup on a throwaway DB, dropped afterwards)
- Restore: 2m26s.
- 8 manual SQL files: under 0.2 s each.
- db push: 2 s, 10 CREATE statements, no data-loss warning; a second push changes nothing.
- Seed: 3 rows.
- 293 Nxeon tables: row counts and checksums identical. 24 new tables. 0 indexes lost; the expression indexes survive.

## Ready
- Pack Loader jar is reproducible and matches its sha pin. It is staged at `/tank/cyrus-rc1-artifacts/`.
- The nginx `/packs/` snippet passed 8/8 checks on a throwaway nginx.
- Build service `/health` checked off the VM: scanner and registry hashes match. A full `docker build` is only possible on VM 88001 (its base image is there).

## Owner inputs
- Preview account: `nicholas.sj.albanese@gmail.com`. It is already the default; add nothing.
- Test server: `minecraft-f3izjh`, owned by that account. Paper 1.21.11, 4 GB/2 cores, node-7. Build for 1.21.11.
- Approve: the code review, the extra subscription usage (one guard call plus test builds), and a Cloudflare WAF skip if a Java client gets a challenge.

## Window
A quiet hour, for example 02:00-05:00 SGT (18:00-21:00 UTC), with no agent build on node-2. The promote takes about 20 min of build, plus about 1 h of supervised testing.

## Ordered commands (details, smoke checks and rollbacks in the runbook)
1. `git -C /opt/nxeon merge --ff-only release/cyrus-rc1`
2. Run the 8 manual SQL files with `psql -1` (the loop in §1b).
3. `promote-production.sh --skip-staging-check`, then `smoke-readonly.sh migrations worker flags`
4. `npx tsx scripts/cyrus-seed-managed-plugins.ts`
5. Create `/tank/cyrus-packs`, add the nginx snippet, `nginx -t && reload`, check the canary download
6. Install the Pack Loader jar to `/tank/cyrus-managed`
7. `TAG=modbuilder:0.6 scripts/cyrus/deploy-modbuilder.sh`
8. Add the `.env` lines, the worker env file and its drop-in; `daemon-reload`; restart the worker, then the web; `smoke-readonly.sh flags worker packs owner`
9. Supervised build → Test Flight → Install on `minecraft-f3izjh` → check in the real client (§6)
10. `smoke-readonly.sh all`
